proof: For M=prod(I+x_i y_i^T), image(M-I) is contained in span(x_i). M=-I implies rank(M-I)=n in characteristic not two. Hence at least n factors.

With exactly n factors their x_i form a basis. In that basis each chronological factor changes only its own coordinate row and adds a functional vanishing on that coordinate. The first changed row therefore has diagonal coefficient +1 and no later factor changes that row. It cannot be a row of -I.
The exact rational replay of the pinned n+1 factors produces -I and each factor satisfies y_i^T x_i=0, attaining the lower bound.
scope: After normalizing ordinary basis changes, the sign specialization uses exactly a product of square-zero rank-one transvections and each HOST provides at most two. Changed native semantics, sign-dependent ordinary operators, other header targets, and extra independent roles are outside scope.
